question: Should the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90098 land with the broadened existing PDF/media config semantics and stale failed-queue cleanup once the PR is rebased and the parser finding is fixed?
rationale: The code defect is repairable, but the PR also changes how existing config fields affect inbound extraction and intentionally drops a class of persisted failed queue items, which are compatibility/session-state choices maintainers should see before merge.

options.title: Fix Before Merge
options.body: Rebase onto current main, port the UI changes into ui/src/pages/chat, replace per-character base64 concatenation, and keep the config/session-state behavior visible in tests and PR notes.

options.title: Narrow To Parsing Only
options.body: Land only stack-safe gateway/UI parsing now and leave pdfMaxBytesMb inbound extraction and stale-queue cleanup for a separate maintainer-sponsored follow-up.

options.title: Pause For Replacement
options.body: Close or pause this stale branch only after a narrower replacement PR exists that preserves the large-PDF extraction behavior and proof.

recommendation.title: Fix Before Merge
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, port the UI changes into ui/src/pages/chat, replace per-character base64 concatenation, and keep the config/session-state behavior visible in tests and PR notes.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the most recent merged large-attachment/base64 safety work that this PR must preserve while rebasing.
